purpose: Preserve initial import provenance and explicitly identify intentional local modifications. New files are covered by MANIFEST.sha256.

.gitignore.reason: Exclude separate fork artifacts and cache.

foundry.toml.reason: Retain the opt-in fork profile, update the vendored OpenZeppelin remapping to authenticated v5.6.1, and select the Cancun EVM target required by its MCOPY implementation.

sdk/configuration.mjs.reason: Retain the quorum prototype mainnet guard and add exact fail-closed validation and deployment commitments for the proof reserve, including immutable verifier, code hashes, reserve policy and DOM activation-schedule identities, safe bounds and unconditional rejection of premature readiness or mainnet claims.

docs/MONITOR.txt.reason: Record selected production-proof requirement, laboratory limits and optional real Rust adapter evidence.

contracts/USDOMReserve.sol.reason: Retain USDT policy and prototype-only mainnet guards; require contract-based governance and guardian roles; fail closed on every uint64 timestamp/bucket narrowing conversion; extract the shared IUSDTPolicy interface without changing prototype behavior.

test/solidity/TestBase.sol.reason: Add log recording and storage-read cheatcodes used to prove the checkpoint registry event ABI and authenticated configuration slot, while retaining prior helpers.

test/solidity/Mocks.sol.reason: Model USDT policy reads, changes and lookup failure; normalize helper assembly formatting with the pinned Foundry formatter.

test/node/configuration.test.mjs.reason: Cover both quorum and proof-reserve mainnet rejection, exact proof and deployment configuration identities including code hashes, reserve policy and the DOM activation schedule, bounds, and rejection of false readiness/real-funds assertions.

config/operator-intent.json.reason: Record explicit native/private USDOM requirements and the isolated checkpoint research direction; preserve the quorum as prototype-only, remove notary/threshold/testnet parameters from the proof-reserve mainnet gate, retain explicit no-deploy/no-real-funds authorization, record the operator's reaffirmed policy that every protocol has residual risk and objective validation plus explicit risk acceptance replace external-audit and zero-risk release requirements, require that future acceptance bind the exact release, source, configuration hashes, report, governance authority and timestamp, and leave the exact release-signing key fingerprint unset until the operator selects it. Add schema 1 so the signed release-intent envelope can be validated with an exact top-level field set and cannot type-confuse the pending-parameter list.

test/solidity/USDOMReserve.t.sol.reason: Model the guardian as a contract, reject EOA guardians, and prove timestamp narrowing fails closed instead of wrapping.

package.json.reason: Force a normal Foundry artifact build before Node integration tests so coverage artifacts cannot make the result depend on command ordering; expose fail-closed release, preflight, finalized-state RISC Zero upstream-health and source-verified unsigned mainnet deployment-package commands; verify import plus complete source-manifest provenance, bounded RISC Zero and host proof-program inputs, panic-free Ethereum-finality, native-state, native-privacy, native-wallet and proof-program production paths; bind the canonical raw-checkpoint positive execution evidence to provenance; and pin the Blake2b implementation used for the cross-language DOM activation commitment.

package-lock.json.reason: Lock the direct authenticated @noble/hashes dependency used to reproduce the Rust Blake2b activation-schedule commitment in the JavaScript release gate.

scripts/candidate-monitor.mjs.reason: Define the guardian boundary as a contract-address transaction executor suitable for a multisig or module adapter.

test/node/evm.test.mjs.reason: Retain the reserve and checkpoint integration; add cross-stack deployment checks for authenticated continuation contexts, confirmation timestamps and finalized-event flow; and differentially prove that both source-derived RISC Zero adapter runtimes, initcodes and configuration hashes equal actual EVM constructor deployments.

test/node/candidate-monitor.test.mjs.reason: Exercise pause transactions through a contract-based guardian adapter, including epoch-bound incident evidence and rotation-race fallback behavior.

scripts/check-configuration.mjs.reason: Select the exact quorum or proof-reserve validator, reject duplicate or resource-exhausting JSON before validation, and preserve the explicit non-readiness result.
